company.name: FlytBase
company.description: Enterprise-grade drone autonomy platform enabling organizations to automate and scale commercial drone operations

core_capabilities.name: Autonomous BVLOS Operations
core_capabilities.description: Schedule, execute, and monitor Beyond Visual Line of Sight drone missions without human pilots on-site
core_capabilities.key_benefit: One pilot can supervise multiple drones across multiple sites

core_capabilities.name: Fleet Management Dashboard
core_capabilities.description: Unified cloud dashboard to manage drones and docking stations across geographically distributed sites
core_capabilities.key_benefit: Centralized command center for all drone operations

core_capabilities.name: Drone-in-a-Box (DiaB) Support
core_capabilities.description: Hardware-agnostic support for automated docking stations that enable 24/7 autonomous operations
core_capabilities.key_benefit: Fully automated drone deployment, charging, and data collection

core_capabilities.name: One-to-Many Operations
core_capabilities.description: Single operator controls multiple drones and docking stations simultaneously
core_capabilities.key_benefit: Dramatically reduces operational costs and personnel requirements

core_capabilities.name: AI-Powered Analytics (Verkos AI)
core_capabilities.description: Computer vision agents for real-time object detection, anomaly detection, and automated responses
core_capabilities.key_benefit: Automated threat detection and intelligent alerting

core_capabilities.name: Flinks Integration Suite
core_capabilities.description: Pre-built connectors for enterprise systems including VMS (Milestone, Genetec), alarm systems, IoT sensors, and analytics platforms
core_capabilities.key_benefit: Seamless integration with existing enterprise infrastructure

core_capabilities.name: Hardware Agnostic
core_capabilities.description: Works with multiple drone manufacturers and docking station vendors including DJI Dock, DJI Matrice series, and others
core_capabilities.key_benefit: No vendor lock-in, mix and match hardware

core_capabilities.name: Mission Planning & Automation
core_capabilities.description: Create automated flight plans, scheduled missions, and trigger-based drone deployments
core_capabilities.key_benefit: Repeatable, consistent data collection without manual intervention

core_capabilities.name: Live Video Streaming & Recording
core_capabilities.description: Real-time video feeds from all active drones with recording and playback capabilities

core_capabilities.name: Safety & Compliance
core_capabilities.description: Built-in flight safety, strategic/tactical deconfliction, Smart-RTH, BVLOS compliance documentation
core_capabilities.key_benefit: Regulatory compliance out of the box

pro_plan.features: Unlimited docks, unlimited users, ideal for scaling from pilot to production

enterprise.features: Dedicated support, custom integrations, on-premise deployment option, SLA, training

competitors.name: Skydio
competitors.weakness: Proprietary hardware only — vendor lock-in. No multi-vendor fleet support.
competitors.flytbase_advantage: Hardware-agnostic. Works with any drone. No lock-in.

competitors.name: DroneDeploy
competitors.weakness: Focused on data processing/mapping, not real-time autonomous operations.
competitors.flytbase_advantage: FlytBase handles live autonomous operations. DroneDeploy is actually a complementary product.

competitors.name: Percepto
competitors.weakness: Closed ecosystem (hardware + software bundle). Limited to their own drone-in-a-box.
competitors.flytbase_advantage: Open platform. Works with DJI Dock, and others. Customer chooses hardware.

competitors.name: Auterion
competitors.weakness: Developer-focused platform. Less turnkey for enterprise operations teams.
competitors.flytbase_advantage: Enterprise-ready out of the box. No development required.
